newsitem.title: UK: Coventry City to float on UK stock market - paper.
newsitem.headline: Coventry City to float on UK stock market - paper.

text.p: Coventry City is to become the latest English football club to join the stock market with a 30 million stg flotation, the Times newspaper said on Monday.
The club has appointed Apax Partners to advise on the float and plans to join the market in April according to the Times.
The money will be used to develop land around the stadium at Highfield Road in the centre of Coventry.
A dozen teams have now joined either the main British stock market or the Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
